summary: Vangan's neighbour fall on the Dang–Navsari line. Advait drops a kilometre from the Ankada Dhodh, doubling the Vansda-side outing.
description:
Advait shares its forest with Vangan's Ankada Dhodh, a kilometre and a half east along the same border-country stream system where Dang runs out against Vansda taluka. The two pins make one outing: whichever fall the season favours, the other is a short walk of the same lanes away.

The record rests on the pin and a traveller's visit; which side of the district line it technically falls on is genuinely unclear and flagged accordingly. Practically it belongs to the Vansda–Waghai orbit, pair it with the national park or Janki Van for the full western day.
highlights: Twin outing with Vangan's Ankada Dhodh
Border-country forest on the Vansda side
Part of the Waghai–Vansda western day

modes.road: Village lanes off the Vansda–Waghai side; ask for the Vangan falls country
modes.rail: Waghai (heritage narrow gauge); Bilimora Jn for broad gauge

access.last_mile: Forest walk from the lane; wet-season slick

seasonality.notes: Monsoon-fed; pair with Vangan while both run.

experience.photography_notes: Forest-framed drops, overcast light suits them.

amenities.food: None. Vansda or Waghai have the nearest food

warnings: Wet rock is slick, grip footwear

tips: Always pair with Vangan: the pins are a short walk apart
Fold Janki Van or the national park into the same western day
